## Canonical-first per workspace AGENTS.md

This is the canonical extension-server template (workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates'). Land the fix here FIRST, then propagate to the 7 sibling extension-server crates in subsequent child beads of bd:JMAP-k9va. Each sibling bead may not land until this one is closed.


`grep -c` says 35 but the list shows 18 lines: `Id::from` matches per-line vs total occurrence count. Re-audit with `rg 'Id::from'` and confirm exact site count before edits.

## Fix shape

For each wire-boundary site, replace:

```rust
let id = Id::from(id_str.as_str());
```

with:

```rust
let id = match Id::new_validated(id_str.as_str()) {
    Ok(id) => id,
    Err(e) => {
        // per-entry SetError for /set update or destroy entries
        not_updated.insert(id_str.clone(), set_error_value(SetErrorType::InvalidProperties, &e.to_string(), Some(vec!["id".to_string()])));
        continue;
    }
};
```

Exact error mapping depends on call site:
- `/set` update map key: invalidProperties into notUpdated
- `/set` destroy array element: invalidProperties into notDestroyed  
- Method-arg field (e.g. EmailSubmission.identityId): top-level invalidArguments error

## Tests

Add at least one negative test per file: a request with an invalid Id (`'id with space'`, `'id\\nwith\\ncontrol'`, or 256-byte Id) is rejected with the appropriate error, not silently accepted.

## Acceptance

- All wire-boundary sites use `Id::new_validated`
- Internal sites (synthetic Ids, backend-return Ids) carry an inline `// out of scope: <reason>` comment
- `cargo test -p jmap-mail-server` green
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-mail-server -- -D warnings` green
- Negative tests landed
- Bead closure prompts the next sibling propagation bead (chat-server)
title: Canonical: jmap-mail-server wire-boundary Id::new_validated migration (35 candidate sites)
